problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must allocate a series of cargo shipments onto identical transport vessels. The shipments are as follows:

* Shipment Alpha: mass 54 metric tons
* Shipment Beta: mass 47 metric tons
* Shipment Gamma: mass 37 metric tons
* Shipment Delta: mass 66 metric tons
* Shipment Epsilon: mass 52 metric tons
* Shipment Zeta: mass 44 metric tons
* Shipment Eta: mass 64 metric tons
* Shipment Theta: mass 48 metric tons
* Shipment Iota: mass 44 metric tons
* Shipment Kappa: mass 45 metric tons
* Shipment Lambda: mass 34 metric tons
* Shipment Mu: mass 63 metric tons
* Shipment Nu: mass 49 metric tons
* Shipment Xi: mass 50 metric tons
* Shipment Omicron: mass 44 metric tons
* Shipment Pi: mass 53 metric tons
* Shipment Rho: mass 70 metric tons

Each vessel possesses a maximum cargo capacity of 100 metric tons. The objective is to assign every shipment to a vessel, ensuring no vessel exceeds its designated capacity, while minimizing the total number of vessels required. Each shipment must be placed in its entirety onto exactly one vessel.
